settings.deleteAccountBody: Kugira ngo usibe burundu konti yawe n'amakuru yose y'ibikoni byawe, andikira {{email}}. Ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
settings.galleryHint: Kanda igihe kirekire ufungure imbonerahamwe y'imiterere (ku miterere y'iterambere gusa)
